name: Call of Cthulhu
description: A general theme for any game system: 1920s cosmic horror after H. P. Lovecraft's public-domain stories, in ink black and sepia with a single sickly-green accent, IM Fell English headings, EB Garamond text and Special Elite typewriter labels, an occult sigil, corner brackets and green diamonds. An unofficial, fan-made look, not affiliated with or endorsed by the owners of the work or game it is named after. Call of Cthulhu is a game by Chaosium.
